protocol: one fixed boundary-consistent noisy density-ratio fit, no FID tuning
optimizer: AdamW beta1=.9 beta2=.999, constant learning rate
precision: FP32 model and inputs, TF32 disabled; FP64 scalar loss
time_distribution: uniform over indices 1..99 of original shifted Euler100 grid; positive signal only
coupling: same label/time/noise, independent uniform real and fake endpoint within class
checkpoint_choice: final update 2048 only; no early stop or validation checkpoint selection
validation: all 5000 fake validation endpoints, one heldout real per class, fixed balanced shuffled native times
entry_condition: heldout mean scaled loss plus two standard errors of 1000 class-cluster means < 0

sampling_if_entry_passed.correction: native original BF16 G plus t^2 grad_z f(z,t,c)
sampling_if_entry_passed.time_window: all original 100 query times including finite t=1 extension

limitations: re-noised endpoints need not equal native trajectory marginals
